title: PI (Personal Income) — real-time vintage table of 2024 estimates as of 2024-09-27
text:
PI — Personal Income
Source: ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED), series PI. Underlying data: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. Units: billions of dollars, SAAR.
Revision schedule: first estimate ~4 weeks after month end; revised monthly and in NIPA annual updates.

VINTAGE TABLE — the value of PI for each reference month exactly as published on each pre-cutoff release (vintage) date. Reading across a row shows how the estimate for that month was revised in later releases.
